digest.component_or_area: close command and STATUS event reducer
propositions: A reader cannot currently distinguish a ticket closed without a completion signature (due to append failure or config unreadability) from one deliberately closed with the gate off, because gate state at close time is discarded and the loss is ephemeral in the returned payload only

The completion_expectation enum (8 values: required, disposition, gate_off, gate_unreadable, force_bypassed, local_source, not_certifiable, not_applicable) must be recorded durably on the close STATUS event in the same locked write that commits the close, never in a separate event

The expectation is computed as the second return value from _completion_precheck by consuming the GateState tri-state, with gate state resolving first (force under disabled/unreadable config records gate_off/gate_unreadable, not force_bypassed), and set explicitly to not_applicable on the idea->closed transition path since it bypasses _completion_precheck entirely

A later reader combining the durable expectation with the durable attestation can separate closed-and-signed (required + attestation), closed-with-signature-lost (required, no attestation), disposition-signed or disposition-signature-lost, and all other cases each identified by their exact expectation value

The field is present-only, backward-compatible, folded on the winning *->closed edge by _fold_close_metadata and declared as a schema enum, with legacy close events lacking the key reducing to state where the key is absent (unknown, never guessed)
